rules.sentence: The findings of this review reinforce the importance of specific immunohistochemical markers in identifying squamous cell carcinoma and its variants.
p40, in particular, stands out for its exceptional nuclear specificity and sensitivity, not only in conventional SCC but also in less-differentiated forms such as sarcomatoid and basaloid subtypes.
Notably, p40 maintains immunoreactivity in sarcomatoid areas where other epithelial markers may be reduced, making it a key tool for confirming epithelial lineage in tumors with spindle morphology.
Although p63 remains highly sensitive, its broader expression in non-squamous neoplasms—such as myoepithelial tumors and lymphomas—limits its diagnostic specificity.
This supports the current consensus favoring p40 over p63 for SCC confirmation.
